# Exact versions the CI builds with -- the ones the last good release was built from.
#
# requirements.txt only gives minimums (PyQt6>=6.5 ...), so without this file every build
# took whatever PyPI had that day. A new upload then broke a release on the day it was
# tagged (2026-11-26: PyQt6-Qt6 6.12.1, out two days before, needed libva on Linux).
#
# To move to newer versions: change them HERE, push, and let the build on main go green
# before tagging.
PyQt6==6.12.1
PyQt6-Qt6==6.12.1
PyQt6-sip==13.13.1
numpy==2.4.6
pygame==2.6.1
py7zr==1.1.4
Pillow==13.0.0
pytest==9.2.0
pyinstaller==6.22.3
pyinstaller-hooks-contrib==2026.10
